title: Hovering the Sales Representative row shows the box, arrow and +
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 1, boards 1.3 and 1.6.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative row and compare with board 1.6.
  2. Measure the box and the + button.
  3. Hover over the + itself.
  4. Move the pointer away, then click into the field with the keyboard (Tab) instead of hovering.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one box around the label and the name together, the same box and height Lead Technician and Service Advisor show on hover, same left edge; the dropdown arrow at the right end, vertically centred on the label and name; the + to the right, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: the box ends 16 px before a 32 px column holding the +; the + is a 32 px square with 8 px corners and a 20 px plus icon, grey on no fill.
  • Step 3: the + shows a light fill.
  • Step 4: while the field has keyboard focus the box, the arrow and the + stay shown.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R4, S1-R5, S1-R11, S2-R1, S2-R2, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 1, boards 1.3 and 1.6, used for the picture to compare against. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The design boards measure about 22 px between the box and the + on the work order card (16 px in the customer window). This case follows the PRD's 16 px; the difference is on the product owner's question list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R4: “Hovering anywhere on the Sales Representative rows shows, on every Sales Representative field at once, the same box Lead Technician and Service Advisor show on hover, around the label and the name together, at the same height as those two fields and the same left edge. The dropdown arrow (S1-R11) and the buttons beside the fields (S2-R1, S2-R8) show at the same time. All of them stay shown while a Sales Representative dropdown or the + menu is open, or while a field has keyboard focus.”
  • S1-R5: “The box ends 16px before the 32px column that holds the + and remove x buttons.”
  • S1-R11: “The dropdown arrow sits at the right end of the field, vertically centered on the label and the name together, the same as on Lead Technician and Service Advisor. With the Labor and Parts fields showing (S2-R5), the arrow sits instead in the bottom-right corner of each field, on the name line, so it never covers the longer label on a narrow or zoomed screen.”
  • S2-R1: “A + button sits to the right of the Sales Representative field: the design system's Tertiary button in its small icon-only size, 32px square with 8px corners, showing the Lucide plus icon at 20px.”
  • S2-R2: “At rest the icon is grey on no fill. Hovering the button shows a light fill. The light fill stays while its menu is open.”
